Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who We Are
 We are seeking a highly skilled Full Stack Developer with a strong emphasis on Java back-end development and AWS infrastructure management. In this hybrid role, you will be responsible for designing and developing scalable microservices while also provisioning, automating, and securing our cloud environments . You will bridge the gap between software engineering and cloud operations, playing a critical role in maintaining our AWS infrastructure and supporting our continuous integration and deployment pipelines.
 What You'll Be Doing
Java & API Development: Design, build, and maintain robust microservices using Java and the Spring Boot framework
Architect and develop secure, high-performance REST APIs to support core business functions
AWS Cloud Provisioning: Manage and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure aligned with technical and business requirements
Handle day-to-day AWS operations, including resource permission management and software upgrades
Infrastructure Automation: Utilize Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, primarily Terraform, to automate infrastructure setup, deployment, and configuration processes
DevSecOps & Platform Security: Embed security best practices directly into the DevOps workflow
Continuously monitor and fortify the platform to ensure vulnerabilities are minimized and compliance standards are met
System Integration: Lead and support integration activities between our core platforms and enterprise systems, specifically focusing on Salesforce integrations
Agile Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional Agile teams (Scrum and Kanban) to deliver high-quality software
 What You'll Bring Along
Software Development: Proven experience in Java development with a deep understanding of microservices architecture and the Spring Boot framework
API Design: Strong background in designing, building, and consuming RESTful APIs
Cloud Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with AWS, including infrastructure provisioning, IAM/permission management, and Kubernetes (EKS) administration
Automation: Proficiency in writing and maintaining Terraform scripts for infrastructure automation
Security: Solid understanding of cloud security principles and experience integrating security into the CI/CD pipeline
Methodology: Accustomed to working in fast-paced Agile environments using Scrum or Kanban frameworks
 JavaScript Experience: Proficiency in modern
JavaScript to support, maintain, and enhance our customer portal front-end
Salesforce Development: Prior experience with Salesforce development, APEX, or deep knowledge of Salesforce integration patterns
